extension.description:
Tubi TV has the largest library of FREE videos of hit and cult TV shows and films.
* Browse the Tubi categories, series and films * Search the Tubi catalogue * Add films and shows to the Kodi library as .strm files * Optional Tubi account sign-in * PseudoTV Live support
extension.disclaimer: Feel free to use this script. For information visit the wiki.
extension.news:
2026.8.10.1 - Moved to Tubi's current API - FIXED: Browsing, search and playback have moved off the retired /oz endpoints and onto the API the Tubi site itself now uses. Nothing in the addon reached a live endpoint before this. - NEW: Categories page properly, series list their seasons, and search returns the full result set. - NEW: Widevine playback through inputstream.adaptive for the titles Tubi encrypts. Titles served in the clear still play without it.
2026.8.10 - Sign-in repaired - FIXED: Signing in no longer uses the retired /oz/auth/login endpoint. The addon now performs the same handshake as the Tubi web client: a signed anonymous device token, then the account login, then the web session handover that yields the cookie the content calls need. - FIXED: The addon no longer dies on startup when the sign-in fails. Tubi is free to browse, so it carries on anonymously and reports the problem. - FIXED: Tokens are cached in the addon profile instead of being fetched on every single browse and playback. - FIXED: Translations are read again (moved to the Kodi 19+ language layout). - NEW: "Clear saved session" in settings for a clean sign-in.
